title: Kinds
description: The tree's levels, and the settings for every node: the kinds part of plat5.yml.

kinds.title: kinds
kinds.description: Map of kind name → kind. Every node in identity is one of these kinds.

reserved_slugs.title: reserved_slugs
reserved_slugs.description: Slugs no node may take, deployment-wide.

deletion_grace.title: deletion_grace
deletion_grace.description: How long a deleted node stays restorable before it's purged. One value for every kind. A duration: a whole number and `s`, `m`, `h` or `d` (`30d`, `12h`). Default `30d`. A change applies to new deletes only.

kind_name.title: kind name
kind_name.description: Lowercase identifier, `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`, max 32. Not `public` or `member`. Names the kind in route scopes, path params, subject fields (`{subject.project_id}`), headers (`X-Plat5-Project-Id`), events (`project.deleted`) and audit. Fixed once nodes exist: a rename reads as a remove plus an add.

parent.title: parent
parent.description: The kind, or list of kinds, a node sits under. Omitted for a root.

label.title: label
label.description: What consoles show. Changes any time.

sign_in.title: sign_in
sign_in.description: `idp`. Marks the one kind people sign in to: a single-node root (the directory), created at boot. Exactly one kind has it.

name_claim.title: name_claim
name_claim.description: On the sign-in kind only. The IdP claim holding a person's name. Default `name`.

segment.title: segment
segment.description: The path segment for generated routes. Slug shape: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, max 63. Default: the kind name with `_` as `-`, plus `s` (`service_area` → `service-areas`).

slug.title: slug
slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter, doesn't end with a hyphen; 3 to 63 characters.

duration.title: duration
duration.description: A whole number and a unit: `s`, `m`, `h` or `d`.
